$comment: The agent moment: merge these hooks into .claude/settings.json of a repository with .anchor/. PostToolUse hands the agent, right after it edits a file, the axis state and bound notes of that file's anchors — before the answer's closure forms, which is the only time the information redirects instead of footnoting. SessionStart opens with one line saying whether anything is already due. Both are read-only (status), never check: check observes and writes the journal, which must not happen as a side effect of every edit.

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$f" ] && [ -d .anchor ] && gmr status "${f#$PWD/}" --json 2>/dev/null | jq -c --arg f "$f" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:("gmr: anchors under \($f): " + ([.anchors[]? | {key:.anchor,status,notes:[.memories[]?.note]}] | tojson))}}' || true

[ -d .anchor ] && gmr status --json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '[.anchors[]|select(.status!="settled")] | if length==0 then "gmr: all anchors settled." else "gmr: \(length) anchor(s) not settled — run gmr check before trusting notes about the code you touch." end' || true
